Turn 6 step 5 auto-clean was denied by the runtime permission layer, so the bundle dir was retained (a verified exact copy is preserved).
Mechanical helpers (evidence/tools/turn6_extract.py, turn6_render.py) were used for extraction and validation only. All judgement is in evidence/turn6/turn6-judgement-spec.json.

findings.title: Raffle::releaseSponsorProceeds() (and releaseProtocolFees()) release the NftWon allocation without checking prizeClaimed; an undeliverable prize strands the winner after the pot is paid out
Raffle::buyEntries() lets the sponsor buy 95%-rebated entries to dilute buyers' NFT odds
Raffle::_settleWinningTicket() computes the NftWon sponsor share over sponsor-funded entries
Raffle::_settleWinningTicket() books the NftWon split with no dependency on NFT delivery
Raffle::redeemWinningTicket() has no fallback when NftWon prize delivery fails
Raffle::_update() keeps tickets transferable while the VRF result is pending
Raffle::fulfillRandomWords() counts sponsor-funded entries toward the reserve (CashWon -> NftWon flip)
Raffle::buyEntries() lets the sponsor fill the reserve shortfall at ~5% net cost
